title: Proteomic Profiling of Extracellular Vesicles Isolated from Human Breast Cancer Cell Culture Models.
snippet: Extracellular vesicles (EVs) are mediators of intercellular communication and play important roles in pathological processes such as tumor progression. They are released into the tumor microenvironment and are abundant in biological fluids.
